content.title: Is Good Friday a state holiday in NJ? Here's what's open, closed
content.text: April 2, 2026, 2:23 p.m. ETEaster is Sunday, April 5, which means Friday, April 3 is Good Friday. It's not a federal holiday, but Good Friday is an official New Jersey state holiday, with state offices, courts, the Motor Vehicle Commission and county offices closed. But is PNC Bank open, is Costco closed, will Shoprite be open, and is UPS closed on Good Friday?Here's what to know about what is open on Good Friday and what is closed on Good Friday in New Jersey this year, including package and mail delivery, banks, post offices, grocery stores, and retailers.New Jersey observes Good Friday as a legal state holiday, meaning private businesses are not required to close or provide paid leave unless individual policies say otherwise. Just a handful of other states recognize Good Friday as a state holiday: Delaware, Connecticut (court holiday), North Carolina, Tennessee, Indiana, Kentucky, and Hawaii. Texas considers it an optional holiday for state employees. Good Friday is a holiday in Canada.While you whip up your Bunny cake for Easter dessert, track down an Easter egg hunt nearby, and search Netflix for an Easter movie for kids now on spring recess, here's what is open and closed in NJ on Good Friday.Is Good Friday a state holiday in NJ?Yes, Good Friday is a NJ state holiday, observed this year on April 3. Easter falls on Sunday, April 5, 2026, and is a "movable feast" in the liturgical year, which means Good Friday and Easter are always on a different day, often a different month, each year. NJ is one of just 12 states where Good Friday is a state holiday.Is the post office open on Good Friday 2026? Is there mail delivery?The USPS is open on Good Friday, April 3, meaning all US post offices are open and mail will be delivered as usual, since Good Friday is not a federal holiday. The NJ state holiday does not impact the USPS or mail delivery.Is UPS open on Good Friday? Will packages be delivered?UPS is open on Good Friday, with UPS pickup and UPS delivery services available. All UPS Store locations are open, according to the UPS website. The NJ state holiday does not impact UPS delivery or store hours on Good Friday. Other delivery options, like FedEx, are open.Is the bank open on Good Friday? Do NJ banks close on Good Friday?PNC Bank, Wells Fargo and most bank branches are open on Good Friday. Banks are not closed on Good Friday because it is a not a federal holiday. The New Jersey state holiday does not mean banks close on Good Friday.Is the DMV open in NJ? Is the MVC closed?The NJ Motor Vehicle Commission (MVC) — formerly called the NJ DMV before 2003 — is closed on Good Friday, April 3. This means none of the NJMVC facilities, licensing agencies, road-test sites and vehicle inspection stations are open. Online services are available 24/7 at njmvc.gov.Is LabCorp open on Good Friday?Yes, most Labcorp locations in NJ are open on Good Friday. Labcorp is not a government agency and does not automatically close for NJ state holidays, meaning you can likely get bloodwork tomorrow morning, April 3, at a Labcorp location near you. Hours are open appointments can be found here.Are stores open on Good Friday? What's closed on Good Friday?Most stores are generally open on Good Friday, April 3, 2026, since it is not a federal holiday. Here are some popular stores in NJ that are open on Good Friday 2026:Grocery stores: Costco, ShopRite, Target, Walmart, Costco, Sam's Club, and Stop & Shop, Kroger, Trader Joe's, Whole FoodsBig-box stores: Home Depot, Lowe's, Kohl's, Best Buy, HomeGoods, Marshalls and TJ MaxxClothing retailers: Old Navy, Dick's Sporting Good and most shopping malls are open (some may close early; check hours at your local mall)Restaurants/coffee chains: McDonald's, Wendy's, Chick-fil-A, Applebee's, Starbucks and Dunkin'Pharmacies/convenience stores: CVS, Walgreens, Rite Aid, Wawa, QuickChek, and 7-ElevenHead here for information on whether the stock market opens or closes on Good Friday, and the market holidays 2026.Lori Comstock is a New Jersey-based news reporter covering trending news with USA TODAY Network's Mid-Atlantic Connect Team. She covers health and other news in the Northeast, including New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, Washington DC, Maryland, and Virginia. Reach her at LComstock@usatodayco.com.
